# Pawan Raj Pandey

> Senior Backend Developer (Python, Django, FastAPI, .NET, gRPC, microservices) based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Volunteer IT Lead for Leo Club of Kathmandu Budigandaki.

Pawan Raj Pandey is a senior backend developer with 4.5+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling production systems. Currently at I.D.E.N.T.V. Nepal — A.I Solution Pvt. Ltd., owning API design, database architecture, microservices, and deployment pipelines for SaaS platforms. Previously at Ayata Incorporation Pvt. Ltd. (Feb 2022 – Jun 2025). Also volunteers as IT Lead for Leo Club of Kathmandu Budigandaki, having designed, built, and maintained the club's official website.

## Experience

- I.D.E.N.T.V. Nepal — A.I Solution Pvt. Ltd. — Senior Backend Developer (Jun 2025–Present, flexible remote): scalable APIs and microservices in Python, Django, FastAPI, and .NET; data layers across PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Qdrant; CI/CD with Jenkins and Docker; RBAC.
- Ayata Incorporation Pvt. Ltd. — Backend Developer (Feb 2022–Jun 2025) and Backend Developer Intern (Jan 2022–Feb 2022): Django backends and REST APIs in production, including iHRTrack.
- Leo Club of Kathmandu Budigandaki — IT Lead, Volunteer (Jun 2026–Present): designed, built, and maintains the club's official website.

## Projects

- [iHRTrack](https://ihrtrack.com/): HR management platform with biometric login, AI-powered facial recognition, RFID access, and geolocation-based mobile check-ins.
- Process Orchestration: Microservices-based SaaS platform spanning KMS, BMS, Orchestration, CMS, and Assessments modules.
- System Intelligence Service: Automated decision-making engine within the SaaS platform.
- Zeta Health: Multi-tenant clinic and hospital management platform with AI-assisted visit summaries.
- [Leo Club of Kathmandu Budigandaki](https://lckbudigandaki.org.np/): Official website for the Leo Club, built end-to-end.
